A few days after the Kikuka Sho. Holding a 
quiet resolve in her heart, King Halo 
appeared at the racecourse in her racing 
attire. "Who's my name—?" "King—!"

"...Accompanied by a mysterious 
self-introduction chant. The media 
joyfully covers her sudden antics, but 
this was all part of King Halo's plan."

She declared that she would head to the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen next. Praying that 
the article would turn people's attention 
back to King Halo once more.

This belongs neither to her mother nor 
anyone else. It was a new declaration of 
resolve from the selfish young lady to 
relentlessly forge "her own path."
